name: find_element
description: Locates a UI element by text, label, or role using hybrid UIA + sub-15ms WinRT OCR. Returns its exact physical screen bounding box [x, y, w, h] and center (cx, cy) coordinates. Supports scope='modal' to target active dialogs.

query.description: Text, label, or element name to spot on screen (e.g. 'Post', 'Apply', 'Discussion', 'Save', 'Cancel').

target.description: Optional window title substring to scope search (e.g. 'Chrome', 'Notepad'). Defaults to full screen or foreground window.

scope.description: Optional search scope: 'modal' restricts search to the active overlay/dialog, completely ignoring background text.
